key_impacts: More than 100 houses damaged in Fenadesal Sur
About 300 residents evacuated to safety in Fenadesal Sur
Bridges ripped away and homes obliterated along the Acelhuate River
evidence_snippets: In November 2009, torrential rains caused floods in El Salvador; 198 people were killed.
Fenadesal Sur got 14 inches of rain in four hours; the Acelhuate River ripped away bridges.
30 houses destroyed, over 100 damaged; 300 residents evacuated safely in Fenadesal Sur.
